An email newsletter is not currently operated from this website. The previous Jekyll subscription placeholder has therefore been retired rather than carried forward as an inactive form.

For current updates, use these public channels:

- [Posts](/blog/) for tutorials, technical notes, and practical methodological explanations;
- [Publications](/publications/) for formal scholarly outputs;
- [Conferences](/talks/) for talks and posters;
- [Software](/software/) for scientific tools and applications;
- [GitHub](https://github.com/qselmer) for repository activity and releases.
